reason: bootstrap.ts runs before `bun install` has installed zod, so it cannot import a zod schema; the restarted child must inherit the full process.env unchanged.
tryParseArgs converts a CommanderError into a numeric exit code (returned fallback) instead of throwing; logging would add stderr text the CLI tests and users do not see today.
main converts a WatcherQueryError into a rendered STATUS verdict on stdout and an exit code (returned fallback); a console.error would add new stderr output.

parseJson throws a WatcherQueryError whose detail is the verdict-visible failure; a console.error would add new stderr output on every retryable JSON parse failure that today is reported only through the verdict.
raw() returns String(value) as a fallback when JSON.stringify throws; logging would add new output and the fallback must stay.
parseRemote returns null for unparsable remotes (fallback used by context discovery); logging would add new output for every non-GitHub remote.
parsePrUrl throws a WatcherQueryError that is reported through the verdict; a console.error would add new stderr output that tests and users do not see today.
checksFastPath returns the `unusable` fallback for a retryable WatcherQueryError so the slow path runs; logging would add new stderr output on a normal path.
attempt converts a WatcherQueryError into a `failed` attempt that the poll loop retries or reports via verdict; logging would add stderr output on every retryable failure.
